title: Derivative of a Power
prompt:
Differentiate with respect to x:

    d/dx [ 3x^2 ]

Enter the derivative as an expression in x.
hint: the power rule: d/dx[a·xⁿ] = a·n·xⁿ⁻¹  →  enter like 6x or 6*x
recap: The power rule: d/dx[a·x^n] = a·n·x^(n-1) — multiply by the exponent, then drop it by one. It differentiates every polynomial term.
